recap.text: In Larracos, thousands of crawlers and leavers look down from the rings as Milk announces a present. Carl's Book of Voodoo splits in two, and Donut shouts that she has a book called A Banquet Fit for a Princess, full of pictures, nice things about her, and spells. The leavers paint a skill or spell onto a page, three each, losing it for good. Eaten, a page returns it briefly, by the quality of the drawing.

Donut's Banquet holds entries from Luca Di, a Pastamancer who tells her it is okay to forgive herself, and Mees Koning 2, a half-orc mage who froze around people. Their spells are Temporary Macaroni, which she casts as a cannelloni tunnel while skulls explode against the shield behind the truck, and Big-Ass Magnet. Every lightning page is removed from it, and Donut eats a dozen lightning spells.

beats.headline: A present in Larracos
beats.text: In the rings around them, thousands of crawlers who mean to take a deal on the next floor, and former crawlers going home, look down as Milk announces a present. Carl's Book of Voodoo splits in two. Donut shouts that she has a book called A Banquet Fit for a Princess, filled with pictures and nice things about her, and spells. Milk taught the leavers to take out a skill or spell and paint it onto a page, three each: one for Carl, one for Donut, one for anyone. They lose it for good. Eaten, a page gives it back for a very short time, depending on the quality of the drawing, and each should carry a personal note of thanks.
beats.gist: Leavers paint skills onto pages for Carl and Donut; eating one returns the skill briefly.

beats.headline: Luca Di's pasta
beats.text: An entry from Donut's Banquet: Luca Di, a human Pastamancer, final level sixty-two, who gave her his train hat on the fourth floor. His mother had dementia, and they were in the dungeon soon after he wheeled her out of her home. On the third floor she took a Benevento, an elf-like witch, and with her mind repaired they could finally talk. She fell during the bubble level. He tells Donut it is okay to forgive herself for War Crime, and that she saved him and his mother's memory. The drawing is a bent tube of pasta. The spell: Temporary Macaroni, cast at level 14.
beats.gist: Donut's Banquet records Luca Di, a Pastamancer, forgiving her for War Crime; the spell is Temporary Macaroni.

beats.headline: A tunnel of cannelloni
beats.text: Skulls pelt and explode against the shield of the car behind. Carl shouts for macaroni, and the truck's windshield shatters. Donut, who has just taken the spell from her Banquet Fit for a Princess, casts Temporary Macaroni, and a tube of pasta fifteen feet tall and twenty wide appears ahead like the mouth of a highway tunnel. The spell casts at level 14, enhanced to 15, and at that level she can choose its size, shape and direction: uncooked, dried cannelloni, at least a foot thick, ten mana a cast. She chains it into a tunnel, and Gluteus slides the truck inside.
beats.gist: Donut casts Temporary Macaroni, chaining cannelloni into a tunnel so Gluteus can slide the truck inside.

beats.headline: Mees Koning's magnet
beats.text: Another entry: Mees Koning 2, a half-orc Boring Ol' Mage, final level sixty-three. He froze around people and stuttered, the race choices only made him uglier, and when a Whoopsie Daisy spell backfired he took two player-killer skulls and was alone. Before the battle at the southern border in Faction Wars, Donut stopped at his stinger unit, said she liked his fangs, and told him about Imani and that we all have scars. He was inside the ball when she cast her Atrocity. The drawing is a curved piece of metal with little electric bolts. The spell: Big-Ass Magnet, cast at level 14.
beats.gist: Donut praises Mees Koning's fangs; he is inside the ball when she casts Atrocity.

beats.headline: Every lightning page
beats.text: The hints about Scolopendra scattered through the dungeon's descriptions all have one thing in common, and Carl has seen it: lightning. So every page in Carl's Book of Boom, Donut's A Banquet Fit for a Princess and the original Book of Voodoo that offered lightning magic has been removed, and the party is strapped head to toe in lightning spells. Donut has eaten a dozen. Even so, killing the centipede is only the backup plan.
beats.gist: Donut's spell books lose every lightning page, arming the party against the centipede.

relations.note: she taught the departing crawlers to paint their spells onto pages
